paper_id: WELL_ Applying Bug Detectors to Bug Localization via Weakly Supervised Learning
title: WELL: Applying Bug Detectors to Bug Localization via Weakly Supervised Learning
motivation: 训练bug定位模型需要大量精确定位标注数据，收集困难耗时，而二值bug检测数据易于获取
problem_framing: 将bug定位问题重新定义为序列标注任务，利用弱监督学习范式训练模型
key_insight: CodeBERT若能检测bug，则bug片段必在其最关注的关键部分（注意力最高处）
method_signature: CodeBERT微调二值检测+多头注意力聚合定位bug，无需定位标注
evaluation_criteria: VarMisuse定位准确率、Top-1/Top-10命中率和Hit@K指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: LSTM backbone表现不如CodeBERT，方法可迁移性有限；假设bug片段连续且有界N
evidence_for_taste: buggy fragment is likely to be included in the key portion
only a small subset of the heads are specialized
LSTM backbone may be not strong enough
thinking_moves: 将检测任务的强标签信号转嫁为定位任务的弱监督信号
利用attention机制提取模型内部学到的bug相关知识
通过 ablation study 验证方法可迁移到其他backbone
承认多头注意力存在冗余，筛选关键head提升性能
